summary.zh: 设计异常层级与输入校验策略
summary.en: Shape exception hierarchies, validation and partial failures.

description.zh: 给出输入校验、异常层级和部分失败处理的常见写法，让错误在合适的层级被捕获和说明。实现校验逻辑、统一异常策略，或让批处理任务在部分失败后继续时使用。
description.en: Covers input validation, exception hierarchies and partial-failure handling so errors surface at the right layer. Use it when adding validation, settling on an exception strategy or making batch jobs survive partial failures.
